learner_operation: Use product and power logarithm rules to expand or combine two factors; on hard items substitute known logarithms into the resulting weighted sum. Associate the exponent on each variable with that same variable’s given logarithm; the displayed evidence must determine the weighted sum.

fixed_features.feature: Two factors with a common valid base; product/power expansion and given-log substitution.
fixed_features.justification: q-79453 and q-98925 both use this operation; tutorial 2796 provides its identities. More factors or quotients would add a reasoning stage outside these hard examples.

fixed_features.feature: Numeric family has two nonunit exponents; symbolic family has one unit exponent, one nonunit exponent and one symbolic given.
fixed_features.justification: Preserves the two observed hard workloads: two short numeric products versus one affine result. Fixing which variable has these roles is unnecessary and is tested independently.

fixed_features.feature: Five radio choices, one correct identity/value; x and y positive and base >1.
fixed_features.justification: All four bank items use five radio alternatives; logarithm domain is mathematically necessary. Conservative bases >1 suffice without a new prerequisite.

fixed_features.feature: Integer exponent/given magnitudes remain small; no fractional exponents sampled as hard.
fixed_features.justification: Two explicit hard cases have integer exponents and givens. The wider lesson has a fractional example but does not establish its hard substitution workload. Negative given logarithms remain realizable by positive x=b^u, y=b^v.

Renaming letters and extending the infinite valid base set does not change the answer-bearing association operation. Both variable assignments are varied, so fixed letters provide no fixed-role shortcut.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Either x or y, independently of which factor is powered.
answer_roles.observed: All four symbol/powered assignments and both signs observed. Controlled x-to-y swap changes k+6 to 3k+2 with exponents fixed.

answer_roles.role: Which variable carries the nonunit symbolic-family exponent
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Either factor; change its exponent while holding the other givens and bank fixed.
answer_roles.observed: Both factors are powered in sampled symbolic cases; minimal exponent changes produce 2k-2 then 3k-2 for each symbolic variable.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary both exponent/value assignments, magnitudes, and signs without changing product/power rules.
answer_roles.observed: All 12 unequal exponent pairs from 2..5, all 12 nonzero givens -6..6, all four sign quadrants, all five bases and both given orders occur in 160 fresh samples.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: All five bank values and positions may be correct when the prompt evidence changes.
answer_roles.observed: 12 controlled sign/factor subgroups each retain a fixed five-value bank and five different correct values; all 60 survive delivery. Raw options are shuffled independently, and the UI further reorders by IDs.

stages_examined: Generator duplicate-answer rejection before key selection
Publisher actual prepare_records normalization, validation and inventory/within-batch deduplication
Actual UI hash-based option ordering and rendering
Learner freshness and difficulty-first weighted selection, with unconfigured/zero-weight branches
delivery.result: At captured basis 4975, all 220 independent and 5 runner records survive; all 12 controlled subgroups retain all five answer roles. Duplicate-answer rejection precedes uniformly selected role, so does not favor a selected key. Faithful read-only selection reproduction retains every eligible subgroup when hard has positive weight. Zero hard weight and consumed history intentionally remove supply; unconfigured policy selects lowest fresh ID rather than sampling uniformly.

limitations: Finite audit cannot prove absence of every possible shortcut. Option-based use of exponent association or arithmetic is intended skill, not automatically a defect.

Selection policy, learner history and future allocated entity IDs are absent from captured inventory. Selection scenarios use explicit synthetic IDs and the actual SHA256 selector algorithm; they show conditional support, not a prediction of a particular live learner draw.
Inventory may change after captured basis 4975; later deduplication can change available coverage. No publication or database writes occurred.

Canonical e-4082 is a demonstration without a captured radio bank and is not separately replayable through the hard generator. Two unrated source banks lack original keys/solutions; their inferred completions are independently checked, not presented as original source evidence.
Easy/moderate, three-factor/quotient tasks, and fractional hard-substitution workloads are not supported or certified.
